entries.subject: eso-optical shipped image lens
entries.finding: Default i/H-alpha/r/G display, 4000 by 3106 pixels over 59.95 by 46.56 arcmin. It colors the conditional coherent front; image intensity does not measure gas depth. The rectangular optical coverage transition remains unresolved.

entries.subject: eso-vista shipped image lens
entries.finding: K/J/Z near-IR display, 3252 by 4000 pixels over 71.84 by 88.35 arcmin, on the same cloud geometry as optical. Different coverage and display color do not imply a second view or calibrated common emission.

entries.subject: Gaia DR3 astrometry/photometry and Bailer-Jones EDR3 geometric distances
entries.finding: 2780 Gaia candidates in an authored 50 pc sphere, G < 14; the delivered budget selects 1500 by brightness with spherical and faint-edge fades. Actual catalogue source IDs, median distances and uncertainty intervals are retained. Sphere, quality cuts, budget, brightness response and fade are display selections, not a membership survey; Cardiel BP-RP display color uses a neutral fallback outside its valid range.

entries.subject: Menten VLBI Orion distance
entries.finding: The adopted 414 ± 7 pc scale places the common frame; it is not a per-pixel cloud-distance measurement.

entries.subject: Wen–O’Dell, Henney and O’Dell central front
entries.finding: The qualified literature and theta1 Ori C coordinate anchor guide a local front hypothesis. Approximate 0.2 pc star/front and 0.1 pc layer scales at the paper distance apply near the core; full-field curvature, depths and support weights remain authored.

entries.subject: Central MUSE diagnostic FITS arrays
entries.finding: Seven complete FITS arrays and headers were inspected, covering about 5.89 by 4.92 arcmin. Missing masks/uncertainties, some units and H-alpha WCS prevent treating them as current numerical constraints; none is fitted.
entries.revisitWhen: Qualify complete WCS, units, masks and uncertainties, then compare a forward observable on the actual small footprint.

entries.subject: Orion-S, Red/Dark Bay and competing Veil geometry
entries.finding: O’Dell/Abel foreground layers and wind bulges and Pabst’s hemispherical Veil are competing interpretations. Local apertures and expansion speeds are not measured dust boundaries or a unique depth field; the shipped single front does not implement their full topology.
entries.revisitWhen: Qualify independent tracer maps and uncertainties and compare separate front/extinction hypotheses without painting neutral foreground matter from optical RGB.

entries.subject: Historical 650 image-detected stars
entries.finding: The lab’s 650 reference-image points and measured aperture-light correction are historical processing evidence. The app replaces this rectangular, depth-conditioned field with Gaia distances; unchanged image counting is not a stellar membership test.
entries.revisitWhen: Retain any future compact anchor only with positive image/source evidence and an explicit conditional-depth exception, never by restoring the whole photographic rectangle.

entries.subject: Optical rectangle and oblique slice traces
entries.finding: The coherent front improved a normalized projected target, but optical coverage still ends visibly and pale residuals/fine bands remain. Old saved-detail result IDs and lab tests do not accept the current physical depth or material.
entries.revisitWhen: Address the source footprint or finite material at its owning layer and verify fixed front, oblique and side views while preserving valid core structure.
